title: Simple Drawstring Pouch
description: A small bag worked from a round base into straight sides with a chained drawstring.
expectationText: A useful small container that teaches the move from a flat circular base into simple upright sides.

steps.title: Start the base
steps.instruction: Make a magic ring or chain 4 and join into a loop.

steps.title: Round 1
steps.instruction: Work 8 single crochet into the center and mark the first stitch.

steps.title: Rounds 2 to 4
steps.instruction: Increase evenly each round until the base is wide enough for a small pouch.

steps.title: Rounds 5 to 14
steps.instruction: Single crochet around without increasing to build the sides.

steps.title: Make the drawstring
steps.instruction: Chain a cord long enough to wrap around the pouch opening, then weave it through spaces near the top edge.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Tie small knots at the drawstring ends, fasten off, and weave in remaining tails.
